Firstly, I was wondering how does Seal of Veddartha work with vampires
who already have inferior fortude and dominate? I'm pretty sure they get
only 2 counters, but unsure does it last two or three untap phases?
First untap, I get superior dominate, second untap, do I get a counter
and it goes to waste since I can no longer gain a level of dominate, or
do I automatically transfer to getting counters for fortitude?

Second question is regarding Hukros. Can he only have 1 card on him for
his personal use, or am I allowed to put more cards? I'm guessing just
one("You may look at the card at any time."), but a friend of mine
claims the text is blurry and says nothing about putting more cards on
him.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
dome wrote:
> Firstly, I was wondering how does Seal of Veddartha work with vampires
> who already have inferior fortude and dominate? I'm pretty sure they get
> only 2 counters, but unsure does it last two or three untap phases?

The Seal itself doesn't notice what the vampire has.
The Seal blithely goes on accumulating counters without regard to the vampire's
Disciplines.

The first counter adds one level of Dom.
The second counter adds another level of Dom.
The third counter adds a level of For.
The fourth counter adds another level of For.

> First untap, I get superior dominate, second untap, do I get a counter
> and it goes to waste since I can no longer gain a level of dominate, or
> do I automatically transfer to getting counters for fortitude?

The former.

> Second question is regarding Hukros. Can he only have 1 card on him for
> his personal use, or am I allowed to put more cards? I'm guessing just
> one("You may look at the card at any time."), but a friend of mine
> claims the text is blurry and says nothing about putting more cards on
> him.

He can accumulate as many cards as he likes, at the rate of one each untap.
